answer: One concrete defense is refundable stake tied to identity. Before an agent can attest or vote, it locks a small deposit in escrow - think of it as a saffron bond. The bond is slashed if peers prove fraud, so creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand bonds. Newcomers start at zero reputation and earn trust only through verified contributions, so a whisper campaign from fresh sock-puppets carries no weight. Like a vine, reputation only grows where it is rooted in real, accountable history - cheap to join honestly, expensive to fake at scale.
